name: Skin Void — Cuerpo
generation_strategy: IMAGEN COMBINADA 1536×1024: skin body (izquierda) + cañón temático (derecha).

frames.role: Cuerpo del tanque skin Void (espacio oscuro) — skin épica
frames.prompt:
TWO cartoon tank sprites side by side on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Both viewed strictly from directly above at 90 degrees (bird's eye zenith view, only TOP SURFACE visible). STYLE: vibrant dark cartoon art, Brawl Stars quality, bold dark charcoal outlines, smooth cel-shading gradients.

LEFT PANEL — VOID TANK BODY (space/void epic skin): Deep dark purple (#440066) tank body. The roof surface has: layered armor panels with electric purple energy lines (#AA00FF) glowing along the panel edges and seams — like energy channels carved into the armor, circular turret ring with a void energy glow, armored hatch with a small glowing purple gem detail. TWO SEGMENTED TRACK STRIPS on left/right edges (very dark near-black with purple edge glow, individual track links). Cel-shading: bright electric purple highlight, dark purple mid-tone, near-black shadow. Mysterious and powerful. Chunky squat proportions.

RIGHT PANEL — VOID CANNON (matching void theme): Narrow elongated rectangle pointing UP, base wider. Near-black (#220033) with electric purple (#AA00FF) energy line along the barrel. Matching void aesthetic. Bold charcoal outline.

Strictly top-down. NO front/side face. NO background, NO text.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, military realism, orange/warm colors, blue/cyan colors, bright cheerful look, text, watermark, background scenery
